author: Notalgicular
body:
You can pretty much guess what Im suggesting, a lottery using credits.
For example, 100 credits gets you put into the random name generator once. The more you buy, the more likely you are to be picked. 
/buy tokens 1000 = 10 times in the random generator for who will win the lottery.
There are 1 ways this could work. 
Once you buy the token for the lottery, they just disappear and whoever wins gets given 100,000 credits or so (Lotterys would take places every week.) or  however much is spent on tokens, is put into the prize draw e.g if 500 people buy 1 token for 100, then the grand prize will be 50,00, if 1466 tokens are purchased then the prize is 146,600 credits ext. 
Opinions?
 Btw, none of this "aww it will make kids addicted to gambling" and all that bullshit because it wont, this is a block game.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
I think the cost of a lottery ticket/token should be about 100 credits, with each ticket/token contributing 75 credits to the prize pool. This will help reduce the amount of excessive credits people will get, since 25% of the credits will be removed from the pool.

Also, I'd recommend a cap at around 50 tickets/tokens per person.
